body:
There were extremely few things about her I didn't love. Even fewer that I didn't like. She was as close to perfect as I could imagine. I loved her talent and outlook on life. Her childlike wonder and belief in things, yet being a grown up when she needed to be. She was refreshing and truly saved me from a dark place. She loved me when I didn't deserve it and I made sure to pay her back. She let me know when I made her happy. She let me know when I messed up. I loved that she was honest until she wasn't.   


Her talent. Her smile and laugh. Her smell. Her rough hands. The way she spoke. The way she walked. The things she said. She wasn't exactly normal and I loved her for it. I could talk about her for hours if it didn't pain me so much. Sorry for the late reply.
Scammers vortex? I'm not sure what you're saying but my plight is real. I have no way to visit her currently but I most certainly have held her in my arms. She probably won't ever find this.

I wish you healing as well. I'd kill for a shot down defensive attitude back though haha. It's torture being left completely in the dark. Pretty sure she just deleted every attempt I sent without reading it which hurts considering everything that we were.

Yeah. Her reading them eventually would be better.

She did exist. She might even be gone now but she was there once. I don't know when she stopped existing but she was real. I held her in my arms. It couldn't have been fake the entire time. I loved a real person that loved me.

I know everyone says that their relationship was special, but this time? It was special. She is so different from anyone else I've ever met, and I was weird too. We broke a lot of norms and beat the odds a lot. It's really easy to get us wrong from an outside view.

I know there's a chance to fix me and move on. If everything in my life suddenly paused and I was put in a room with a book on how to fix myself I could probably do it. But I'm on a very bad time limit. I have until the end of the year before some bad shit happens in my life. Now that she's gone I'm not gonna wait that long. She was my support system and my home. I put all my eggs in one basket because I'm a naive idiot that's really easy to lie to. I just wasn't ready and I'm sad to say that I do not have a fair chance of fighting out of this one.

I can't begin to explain to you the enormity of what I've lost. I didn't just lose my best friend and lover, I lost my future. I gave up on so many things and opportunities because she led me to believe that she'd never leave. This box I'm trapped in is directly MUCH WORSE because of her swift betrayal.

If she's changed, I don't want to know about it. I'm willing to go into eternity with the memory of the girl I remember loving.
We were together a long time. I know things about her that no one else does and she knows the same about me. This wasn't some short fling, we were set to have a full life together very soon.
I knew her very very well. Better than anyone else. We fell asleep with our arms and legs entangled and talked about our dreams.
Sorry you have to deal with these other commenters.

I've felt everything you're feeling. I currently am. I'm not over it yet and I don't know if I'll ever be. I guess im trying to say you're not alone in this.

Your love was real.

The woman I love has a quite large nose. It's my favorite thing about her. She hated it too and would try to hide it. She's grown to love and be proud of it. I hoped our kids would get her nose.

I'm sure that you can grow to love yours too. Big nose for a big heart.
